name: Don
source:
"I shamelessly used your stomach to get to your heart."

Don loves jazz, a good belly laugh, and bringing smiles to people’s faces. He’s fun, sweet, and puts the whole room at ease. The audience of the dating show absolutely adores Don and his cheesy (nutty) jokes. His comedy tours allow him to sample glorious food around the globe, and he happily offers to share his experiences. Don retreats when confronted by serious questions. Can Hazel uncover what lies under Don’s shield of humor?
